entities.summary: The Ferhadija Mosque, also known as the Ferhat Pasha Mosque, is a mosque located in the Baščaršija neighbourhood of the city of Sarajevo, in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The mosque was built in the 16th century by Bosnian Sanjak-bey (governor) Ferhad-beg Vuković, a descendant of the famous medieval Vuković family.
